text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up: PR #8621 (kv-cache quant fix) needs a second approver before midnight cutover. CI is green except a flaky macos-12 smoke that looks unrelated. @Liz @Kai can you give a quick second eye? Cutoff 23:59 PT. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8621 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Liz Chen: looking now, will run the smoke locally. can we cut a canary if it gets through? :eyes:
Kai Nakamura: quick skim — changes are small, mostly quant table bump. left one inline comment on the PR about lock ordering in kv_cache.hpp. If that's a race we should fix before merge.
Samir Patel: thanks. is that behavioral or just a doc/comment? if it's behavioral we should hold; if it's a clarify/fix I can merge after a follow-up patch.
Kai Nakamura: it's potentially behavioral — ordering could allow reorder on eviction. @Priya can you confirm? you owned the original kv cache commit.
Priya Gupta: on it, running a focused stress smoke with concurrent writers. will run for 10–15m and post logs.
releaser-bot: NOTE: Cutoff timer set for 23:59 PT. If approvals are not present by cutoff, autobackout policy may trigger for this hotpatch.
Priya Gupta: update — ran 12m with 200 concurrent worker threads, exercised eviction heavily, could not reproduce the race. logs attached on the PR (artifact: ci/pr-8621/stress-2025-06-18-logs.txt). I also added a stronger assert in a follow-up commit to catch regressions.
Kai Nakamura: looked at the logs and the extra assert. makes sense, comment resolved. I'm happy to approve once the follow-up commit is squashed or landed as a separate PR with the assert. Approved from me. :white_check_mark:
Liz Chen: smoke passed locally after the follow-up commit. Verified metrics for kv hit/miss look normal. Approved. :rocket:
Samir Patel: great — two approvals. I'll merge during the low-traffic window at T-5. @releaser-bot, start canary rollout to 3 nodes and watch health checks.
releaser-bot: Canary initiated on nodes canary-01..03. Health checks: 0/3 failed, streaming logs to #incidents for the next 30m. Will post if any regression detected.
Taylor Brooks: I'll monitor logs and take pager if something alerts. If we see an increase in 5xxs we'll autobackout immediately. Thanks for the quick turnaround team. :thumbsup:
